What do you think about making `label` format strings, so that users can write e.g. `[REBASING](bold green)` to change the styles?

```suggestion
            .map_meta(|variable, _| match variable {

```

Can these two be combined?

```suggestion
            .map(|variable| match variable {
                "progress_current" => state_description.current.as_ref().map(Ok),
                "progress_total" => state_description.total.as_ref().map(Ok),
                _ => None,
            })
```
I think that's a good change! Should I update the docs to reflect this somehow?
